generatedFiles.content:
# Multi-stage Dockerfile for a CRaC (Coordinated Restore at Checkpoint) image of app.
#
# This scaffold was generated by BootUI for the application the starter is installed in.
# It assumes a single-module Spring Boot application built with the Maven Wrapper.
#
# This JDK 21 scaffold attempts a startup checkpoint after non-lazy singleton
# initialization, before lifecycle start; it is not a fully warmed-up application.
# Early-opened resources may still need checkpoint handling. This CRIU-based
# recipe uses Linux and CHECKPOINT_RESTORE, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_ADMIN (with Docker's
# default /proc restrictions) and NET_ADMIN (to recreate network interfaces).
# Verify the exact JDK, CRIU, kernel and CPU combination separately. The companion
# checkpoint-and-run.sh entrypoint (generated alongside this file and expected at the
# project root) takes the checkpoint on the first start and restores it afterwards.
#
# Build and run (the named volume keeps the checkpoint
# between restarts, and -p publishes the port so the app is reachable from the host):
#   docker build -f Dockerfile-crac -t app .
#   docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 \
#     --cap-add=CHECKPOINT_RESTORE --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN --cap-add=NET_ADMIN \
#     -v app-crac:/opt/crac/checkpoint app
# These capabilities grant broad host access. Use this image only for local
# development on an isolated machine; do not deploy it to production or a shared host.

# Build stage (a plain JDK is enough; CRaC only matters at runtime).
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-noble AS build

WORKDIR /app

# Copy the project (see .dockerignore for exclusions).
COPY . .

# Make the Maven Wrapper executable.
RUN chmod +x mvnw

# Build the repackaged, runnable Spring Boot jar.
RUN ./mvnw -DskipTests clean package

# Move the runnable jar to a known path (the repackaged boot jar, not a *-plain.jar or
# *.jar.original produced alongside it).
RUN set -e; \
    app_jar=$(find target -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' ! -name '*-plain.jar' ! -name '*.jar.original' | head -1); \
    if [ -z "$app_jar" ]; then echo "ERROR: Spring Boot jar not found"; ls -laR target | head -40; exit 1; fi; \
    cp "$app_jar" /app/app.jar

# Runtime stage with a CRaC-enabled JDK (BellSoft Liberica with CRaC support).
FROM bellsoft/liberica-runtime-container:jdk-21-crac-slim-glibc

WORKDIR /app

# Where the checkpoint image is written/read. Mount it as a volume so the checkpoint
# survives container restarts.
ENV CRAC_CHECKPOINT_DIR=/opt/crac/checkpoint
ENV APP_JAR=/app/app.jar
# Spring Boot's Hikari checkpoint lifecycle suspends new borrows before draining the pool.
# This setting alone does not prove pool ownership or cleanup of early-opened resources.
ENV SPRING_DATASOURCE_HIKARI_ALLOWPOOLSUSPENSION=true

# Copy the repackaged jar and the checkpoint/restore entrypoint generated alongside this file.
COPY --from=build /app/app.jar ${APP_JAR}
COPY --from=build /app/checkpoint-and-run.sh /app/checkpoint-and-run.sh

RUN chmod +x /app/checkpoint-and-run.sh && mkdir -p ${CRAC_CHECKPOINT_DIR}

EXPOSE 8080

# Take a checkpoint on the first start, then restore on every start.
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/checkpoint-and-run.sh"]
